selected_guidelines.name: TRIPOD+AI
applicable_tastoria_studies: P1: CV Ingredient Detection & Counting (regression/counting + box prediction)
P2: CV Produce Freshness & Probability Calibration (3-class ordinal + calibration)
P3: Meal Recommender Systems (Food.com implicit + VN explicit survey Ranker)
P4: Ingredient Substitution & Combinatorial Tray Composer

topic_mapping.label: Data source, participants, setting, and outcome definition
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: P1: Open Images V7 + Mendeley Bangladesh + LVIS v1 + RPC Checkout + Omorros Kitchen (14,023 v1 / 20,638 v2 images, 5,327 non-commercial); P2: AgriFreshNET (5,183) + Local Spinach Leaf v3 (3,999) = 9,182 originals, 2,366 d8dedup4 groups, 3-class vs backend 4-class kiem_tra gap; P3: Food.com 5-core (16,043x37,851, d_val=2010-06-24, d_test=2012-04-01) & VN Survey (SIMULATED=true, n=90, 180 KB recipes); P4: 232 KB ingredients, 197 pairs (32 dev / 75 test), 90 queries (0 human answers), 150 synthetic composer scenarios (75 tuning / 75 test).

topic_mapping.label: Predictors, sample size, missing data, and class balance
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: P1: 640px RGB inputs (none/GW/CLAHE ablations), 30 covered classes vs 7 zero-box VN classes; P2: 224x224 GrabCut-masked RGB + 81-dim classic features (HSV+LBP+GLCM+Lab+fg), class counts (tuoi=3,809, dung_som=1,643, dung_ngay=3,730, local_spinach has 0 dung_som); P3: Food.com 1,882 item tags/ingredients + temporal interaction history, VN survey 160-dim recipe attributes + 724 never_eaten missingness; P4: 100d Word2Vec + nutrient + PMI vectors, fridge inventory/urgency/TEE constraints.

topic_mapping.label: Model development, tuning, validation, and updating
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Strict train/val/test isolation: P1 pHash<=4 dedupe in order test->heldout->val->train and 10-frame video block clustering; P2 StratifiedGroupKFold (5 folds x multiple seeds) on d8dedup4 groups with out-of-fold Temperature/Platt calibration; P3 temporal global cutoff on Food.com and 5-fold nested CV on VN survey; P4 dev/test ingredient split (32/75) and tuning/test scenario split (75/75, 71 feasible tuning).

topic_mapping.label: Performance, uncertainty, calibration, discrimination, and utility
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Shared tastoria_ml.stats inference: point estimates + 95% bootstrap/cluster CIs + effect sizes (Cohen's dz / Hedges' gz / rank-biserial / Cliff's delta) + Holm-Bonferroni (confirmatory) & BH-FDR (exploratory). P1: mAP50, mAP50-95, size AP, Counting MAE, CPU ONNX p50/p95/p99; P2: Macro-F1, QWK, ECE, adaptive ECE, Brier, NLL; P3: NDCG@10, HR@10, AUC, graded NDCG; P4: MRR, Agreement@3, urgency U(m), taste loss, |Delta E|/E <= 0.15 rate, CP-SAT solve latency.

topic_mapping.label: Subgroups, fairness, interpretability, model access, data, and code
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Subgroup/gap reporting: 7 VN zero-box classes (thit_lon, thit_ga, su_su, muop, rau_cai, rau_muong, gia_do), Food.com activity bins & 599 cold items, VN survey SIMULATED=true boundary, 5,327 non-commercial CV images & AGPL-3.0 vs Apache-2.0 detector licensing, SHA-256 serving manifests in deploy/models/.

selected_guidelines.name: STARD 2015
applicable_tastoria_studies: P1: CV Ingredient Detection & Counting (diagnostic presence/absence + box/count accuracy)
P2: CV Produce Freshness & Probability Calibration (3-class diagnostic classification + abstention)

topic_mapping.label: Participant selection, setting, design, and data collection
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Retrospective public dataset assembly with pHash<=4 cross-split deduplication (P1: Open Images V7, Mendeley BD, LVIS v1, RPC, Omorros; P2: AgriFreshNET + Local Spinach Leaf v3, augmented copies excluded, label conflicts excluded).

topic_mapping.label: Index test, reference standard, thresholds, and blinding
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Index tests: YOLO detectors (conf chosen strictly on val), Freshness SVM/MobileNetV3/EfficientNet/ResNet + calibrated softmax thresholds. Reference standards: dataset bounding boxes (excluding OI IsGroupOf==1 for counting) and dataset freshness labels mapped to {tuoi, dung_som, dung_ngay}.

topic_mapping.label: Accuracy estimates, uncertainty, missing, and indeterminate results
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Per-class AP, macro-F1, QWK, ECE/Brier/NLL with 95% cluster-bootstrap CIs; explicit handling of indeterminate/abstention zone (kiem_tra uncertainty threshold analysis) and 7 zero-box VN classes.

topic_mapping.label: Participant flow, timing, adverse events, and applicability
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Dataset filtering flow (e.g., 18,159 manifest rows -> 9,182 originals -> 2,366 d8dedup4 groups; 418/386 CV pHash drops), CPU ONNX runtime latency p50/p95/p99, domain-shift caveats (non-Vietnamese public produce vs local kitchen photos).

selected_guidelines.name: STARD-AI
applicable_tastoria_studies: P2: CV Produce Freshness & Probability Calibration

topic_mapping.label: Dataset provenance, model version, training status, and access
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Dataset versions/licenses (15,311 commercial-ok vs 5,327 NC in yolo_v2; CC BY 4.0 AgriFreshNET/Spinach), package versions (ultralytics==8.4.215, torch==2.8.0+cu126, onnxruntime==1.31.0 in .venv vs onnxruntime==1.32.0 in ml/runs/venv-cv), MLflow SQLite run IDs, ONNX + serving.json SHA-256 provenance.

topic_mapping.label: AI index-test execution, human interaction, thresholds, and reference standard
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Deterministic inference preprocessing (640px RGB / 224x224 GrabCut letterbox), fixed NMS IoU/conf thresholds selected on val, OOF calibration fit without test leakage, and human-in-the-loop correction/kiem_tra fallback design.

topic_mapping.label: Subgroups, fairness, failure cases, uncertainty, and generalizability
topic_mapping.tastoria_mapping: Size-stratified AP (small/medium/large), per-source and per-produce breakdown (AgriFreshNET vs Local Spinach), 7 VN zero-box failure boundary, and cross-source generalization limits.
